integrity: Full deterministic finite computation can be reconstructed from the included standard-library verifier; the matching gives ordinary integral homotopy, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for Paley graph on 17 vertices and closed-neighborhood convention.
No classification of inclusion maps, automorphism-group action, other Paley orders, or other Čech radii.
Bibliographic novelty has residual unindexed-work risk.
title: Fifty-two three-spheres in the Paley-17 closed-neighborhood complex
